title: Terminal-outcome taxonomy v1 (audit section 10, step 6)
doctrine: Every user-flow termination classifies into EXACTLY ONE of the four declared classes. A termination is any invocation-ending exit of scripts/run_user_flow.mjs: a finish() result (status + outcome) or a thrown run (typed internal outcome / handoff refusal). The class answers one question — WHAT KIND OF THING ENDED THIS RUN — and is deliberately a different axis from the workflow-state contract's blocker_class ownership field: blocker_class says who owns the state, this taxonomy says what the termination IS. Because INTERNAL_WORK work resumes automatically by contract (response_contract.BLOCKED_INTERNAL), it can never be a TERMINAL class: anything declared terminal in the delivery-blocker constitution must be a human decision or a constitutional review gate.

USER_DECISION.definition: Review gate that requires a human: the run stopped because a person must decide, answer, or supply something only they hold.

INTERNAL_WORK.definition: Missing inputs or capability debt owned by the controller: an internal defect, budget exhaustion or bootstrap failure that must resume or be repaired internally and is never a user question.

MISSING_FIXTURE_APPROVAL.definition: External custody or approval absent: a fixture, installed capability, or signed handoff living outside the controller's custody was not provided, so the run cannot lawfully start or continue.

REVIEW_GATE.definition: Constitutional pause: a sealed boundary (run-case integrity seal, equation system, workbook integrity, manual review gate, staged checkpoint) halts the run for review instead of proceeding; nothing was invented to get past it.

SCREEN.rationale: The product route did not execute; control is handed to the human operator at the company screen session.

PAUSED.rationale: A staged checkpoint or review-gate pause (stop-after, review seal refusal, review gate reply, change request): the constitution halts the run instead of proceeding unreviewed.

ACTION_REQUIRED.rationale: The flow asked a consolidated human question (displayed questions, incomplete answer file, unresolved forecast authority) and requires an explicit reply.

BLOCKED.rationale: A terminal delivery block. The status itself owns no class: the termination's class comes from exactly one outcome_codes entry, bound by normaliseUserFlowResult to the delivery-blocker constitution's fatal_reason and blocker_domain.

PASS_PENDING_MANUAL.rationale: The workbook cleared every automated gate and was delivered, but delivery remains pending MANUAL verification: a constitutional review gate on the completion claim itself.

bad_inputs.rationale: The supplied inputs could not establish the issuer/period basis; a human must supply better inputs.

filings_incomplete.rationale: The filing corpus the human holds is incomplete; only they can complete it.

entity_stop.rationale: Issuer identity stayed unresolved after controlled acquisition; a human must settle who is being modelled.

reconciliation_stop.rationale: No defensible opening-debt position remains after every lawful source is exhausted; a human must supply the reconciling instrument.

awaiting_reexport.rationale: The run waits on a re-export that only the document's human custodian can perform.

bad_evidence.rationale: Supplied evidence failed validation; a human must provide evidence that validates. (Controller-owned blocker_class records repair ownership, not the termination's kind.)

answers_incomplete.rationale: The answer file does not settle every displayed question; the human must finish answering.

forecast_authority_unresolved.rationale: Material forecast states remain unresolved after the authority waterfall; one consolidated user decision is required (INPUT_REQUIRED quality mode).

run_case_mutated_during_pause.stage_note: also emitted at build_checks on resume
run_case_mutated_during_pause.rationale: The integrity seal found the paused case mutated; the constitution refuses continuation until a human reviews and starts a fresh run.

decision_replay_blocked.rationale: The recorded decisions cannot be replayed against the freshly compiled case without inventing an input: the equation-system boundary pauses the run for review rather than fabricating.

decision_graph_blocked.rationale: The decision graph cannot solve within its constitution; the boundary is a review gate, never an invented answer.

case_recompile_blocked.rationale: Recorded decisions did not recompile into a clean case: an internal compiler finding at a constitutional boundary, held for review.

workbook_build_blocked.rationale: The workbook cannot be emitted or validated without corruption: the workbook-integrity boundary halts delivery.

delivery_attestation_blocked.rationale: The delivered artifact cannot be attested: the attestation boundary refuses the completion claim.

INTERNAL.compiler_or_graph_defect.rationale: A thrown run carrying no more specific typed outcome: capability debt owned and repaired internally.

INTERNAL.runtime_budget_overrun.rationale: The compute ceiling ended the invocation: internal resource debt, charged and resumable.

INTERNAL.runtime_bootstrap_failed.rationale: Runtime bootstrap failed before the product route: internal capability debt.

INTERNAL.forecast_completion_escalated.rationale: Forecast completion escalated past its internal authority: owned internally, never surfaced as a user question.

INTERNAL.forecast_ownership_blocked.rationale: Forecast ownership preflight blocked: internal capability debt.

INTERNAL.host_precondition_unsatisfied.rationale: A declared host capability (workbook engine, python, custody fixture) is absent from the environment: external custody absent, not an internal defect.

INTERNAL.controller_handoff_refused.rationale: The parent controller's signed handoff token is absent, expired or invalid: the approval custody needed to start a child run is missing, so the run refuses before executing any product route.

forecast_plan_blocked.rationale: E1 semantic gate: a material forecast state is BLOCKED (unresolved+blocking). Capability debt owned internally — resumes automatically after repair; never a user-facing delivery block.

PASS.context: skill-integrity-evidence/1.0 closing receipt written inside finish(); an artifact status, never a user-flow termination

static_extraction_contracts.status_literal_pattern: \bstatus:\s*"([A-Z_]+)" (applied to scripts/run_user_flow.mjs; result set must equal terminal_statuses keys plus non_terminal_status_literals keys, both directions)
static_extraction_contracts.outcome_emission_pattern: \boutcome:\s*"([a-z_]+)" (applied to scripts/run_user_flow.mjs; result set must be a subset of outcome_codes keys)
static_extraction_contracts.outcome_coverage_rule: every outcome_codes key with surface user_flow_* must appear as a string literal in scripts/run_user_flow.mjs
static_extraction_contracts.exit_zero_rule: terminal_statuses whose process_exit_code is 0 must equal the zero-exit status list asserted in guardedMain().then()
